## anarchist, illustrator, reluctant security engineer

Howdy! I'm errbufferoverfl. Welcome to Bits & Bytes. I'm happy you're here — please make yourself comfortable. By day, I'm the reluctant security engineer working on browser-based ecosystem security and OAuth stuff. By night I'm a gardener, knowledge librarian & artist. I currently live on the unceded land of the Boandik Peoples.

I'm passionate about social-anarchy, anti-capitalism & revolution; my main focuses are subsistence-farming, sustainable living, subverting surveillance capitalism, peer to peer technologies and anything I'm hyper fixated on at the time.

_Bits & Bytes_ is exactly that—bits and bites of work, part digital garden, part knowledge base. It’s a dynamic, living document that serves as both a project repository and a knowledge base, where I gather fragments of thoughts, ideas, and ongoing projects as they evolve over time.

Welcome, I'm glad you're here, feel free to [poke around](/notebook).
